title: Purple Ukrainian Vine Large Tomato – 2x Mini Plug Plants - High Yield Variety
description:
Purple Ukrainian Tomato – 2x Mini Plug Plants
 

 A stunning Ukrainian heirloom variety prized for its deep purplish-black, plum-shaped fruits. Each tomato reaches 3–4 inches long and around 6oz, with a sweet, rich, meaty flavour that's hard to beat.


 An outstanding all-rounder — equally at home sliced fresh into salads, slow-roasted into passata, or cooked down into rich sauces. The dense, meaty flesh makes it a fantastic choice for canning too.


 Well suited to the UK climate thanks to its natural cold tolerance, this indeterminate variety is known as an early cropper with an elegant growing habit and good resistance to late blight. Expect an abundant harvest of beautiful dark-skinned fruits throughout the season.


 You will receive 2x small plug plants, carefully packaged for safe delivery. Plants are young and vigorous, ready to pot on or plant out once risk of frost has passed.
